decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has kept a page of its own in both years, which signals results that meet aspirations and continued investment, so there is no shortfall to trigger search for alternatives.
The hyaluronic serum fits the core offer and has stayed listed for two years in a growing industry, so its results appear satisfactory despite a less prominent presentation.
The cleansing oil is new and its results are still uncertain, but it likely took over the cleansing role of the dropped cleansing milk, so a small firm in a growing market would keep it for now.
